definitions.gloss: valvular heart disease; heart valve disease
definitions.explanation: Any disorder of the heart's valves in which they fail to open or close properly. Most often the full phrase is {心臓弁膜症|しんぞうべんまくしょう}, but {弁膜症|べんまくしょう} alone is common.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{弁膜症|べんまくしょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{診断|しんだん}→診断：04209_shindan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My father was diagnosed with valvular heart disease.

examples.japanese: {弁膜症|べんまくしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{加齢|かれい}→加齢：11821_karei⟧⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Valvular heart disease increases with age.

examples.japanese: ⟦{重度|じゅうど}→重度：28683_juudo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弁膜症|べんまくしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Severe valvular heart disease can require surgery.

notes:
Compound of {弁膜|べんまく} (membrane valve) + {症|しょう} (disease, ailment). The {症|しょう} suffix is widely used to form names of medical conditions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{心臓|しんぞう}→心臓：03262_shinzou⟧{弁膜症|べんまくしょう}: heart valve disease (full medical term)
- {弁膜症|べんまくしょう}⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧: valve surgery
- {僧帽弁|そうぼうべん}{閉鎖不全症|へいさふぜんしょう}: mitral regurgitation (a specific form)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{不整脈|ふせいみゃく}→不整脈：07104_fuseimyaku⟧: arrhythmia — irregular heartbeat, a different kind of heart condition
- ⟦{心筋梗塞|しんきんこうそく}→心筋梗塞：20487_shinkinkousoku⟧: heart attack — sudden blockage, distinct from chronic valve disease
